the reaction between diacetylpyrrole and acetylene in a one-potent procedure in the presence of a strong base (MOH) at high temperature and pressure affords bis(pyrrol- 2-yl) pyridines and their derivatives.

the synthesis of the title compounds is possible by a one-step procedure, that the cis-cistrans conformation of the title compounds has the lowest energy, that the cis-trans-to-transtrans isomerization of 4 is possible, and that the cis-ciss-trans isomerization of this compound is impossible.

the reaction of diacetylpyryliums with acetylene leads to the formation of a variety of bis(pyrrol-yl)pyryliums, which have been isolated in a one-pet procedure in high yields and their structures and spectral characteristics studied.

the synthesis and structure of novel pyrrole-pyridines.
the synthesis of novel pyrrole-containing heterocyclic compounds and their application in the preparation of new functional materials.

the reaction of diacylpyridines with acetylene under the conditions described in our paper leads to a variety of products.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of bis(pyrrol-yl)pyrrole derivatives is a very simple process, requiring only a one-pot reaction between diacetylpyrrole derivatives and acetylene under mild conditions.

the reaction of oxime of the corresponding diacylpyridine and acetylene in the presence of alkali metal hydroxides in DMSO under high pressure and high temperature conditions is a general procedure for synthesis of a wide variety of dipyrrole-pyrrolines.

the reaction of oximes with acetylene can be used to synthesize various dipyrrole–pyridine assemblies and N-vinyl or acetyl derivatives of them, thus illustrating the general character of this process.
